verification.result: 63 modules transformed; production build passed; CharacterLab remains a lazy chunk
2/2 browser tests passed serially in 23.9 seconds, including character lab and full captain route

defectsClosed.issue: The implemented character lab had no route from App.
defectsClosed.rootCause: CharacterLab was produced after the initial App composition and never added to the query-route switch.
defectsClosed.change: App now selects CharacterLab for ?lab=character without conditionally invoking hooks.
defectsClosed.evidence: Playwright locates the heading, 12 action buttons, camera presets and debug toggles.

defectsClosed.issue: Parallel WebGL E2E intermittently missed combat timing assertions.
defectsClosed.rootCause: Two Chromium workers competed for software WebGL and delayed actionability checks beyond the combat telegraph.
defectsClosed.change: Graphical E2E runs with one worker; timing-critical clicks skip redundant stability waiting after the cue is already asserted visible.
defectsClosed.evidence: Both browser paths pass in 22.8 seconds.

defectsClosed.issue: Screenshots were written into a duplicated nested games path.
defectsClosed.rootCause: Screenshot paths assumed repository-root CWD while Playwright runs from the game package.
defectsClosed.change: Evidence paths are now relative to the game package runs directory; the malformed nested directory was removed.
defectsClosed.evidence: Both expected PNG evidence files exist in their indexed run directories.

defectsClosed.issue: The solid rear-hair mass occluded the face, while long fringe pieces hid both eyes.
defectsClosed.rootCause: The hair cap extended in front of the face shell and the front cones reached below the eye line.
defectsClosed.change: Moved and flattened the rear hair volume, shortened the fringe, added a narrow central bang and layered warm iris/pupil geometry.
defectsClosed.evidence: Fresh front and three-quarter browser inspection shows both eyes, brows, nose and mouth readable without losing the black faceted-hair silhouette.

defectsClosed.issue: The ochre cloak tail read as two detached spearheads and attack trails remained visible after the swing window.
defectsClosed.rootCause: The tail used separated octahedra and trail visibility depended only on the selected action id.
defectsClosed.change: Replaced the tail with one continuous extruded ribbon and bounded trail visibility to each action's active presentation window.
defectsClosed.evidence: Fresh material capture shows a continuous shoulder-to-tail ribbon; the trail appears during the heavy key pose and clears after its timed window.

defectsClosed.issue: Raised weapon poses approached the viewport edge.
defectsClosed.rootCause: Camera presets were framed only against the neutral 3.2-unit standing silhouette.
defectsClosed.change: Moved all four presets back and raised their target slightly to reserve action-safe headroom.
defectsClosed.evidence: The fresh heavy-action screenshot keeps character, raised shaft and complete cyan arc inside the stage.

truthBoundary.knownGap: Procedural pose groups do not prove production topology, skinning, root motion, foot locking or weapon collision. The reference contains front, left and back full-body views plus a face close-up; unseen right-side construction remains a symmetric inference.
truthBoundary.performanceEvidence: A separate 60-second Playwright run under Chromium SwiftShader software rendering measured about 27.62 average FPS. This is below release thresholds but does not establish player-GPU performance; a hardware-accelerated capture is still required.
truthBoundary.visualInspection: Fresh 1600x900 material and wireframe captures show readable eyes, open-front mantle, continuous ochre ribbon, full raised-weapon silhouette and action-safe framing. This remains graybox evidence, not Gate 3 approval.
